ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { status: "SUCCESS", message: "Daily ticket CSV report generated and emailed to management successfully", fileName: vars.finalFileName, recordCount: vars.recordCount, exportPath: p('report.exportDir') ++ "/" ++ vars.finalFileName, archivePath: p('report.archiveDir') ++ "/" ++ vars.archiveRelPath, reportPreview: vars.csvContent }

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: ((now() as DateTime) as String {format: "yyyy/MM/dd"}) ++ "/TICKETS_" ++ ((now() as DateTime) as String {format: "yyyyMMdd"}) ++ ".csv"

salesforce:query.doc:name: Query Tickets in Window
salesforce:query.salesforce:salesforce-query: SELECT Id, Name, Customer_ID__c, Customer_Tier__c, Product_Code__c, Category_Code__c, Priority__c, Assigned_Team__c, Ticket_Status__c, Acknowledgement_Due_At__c, Resolution_Due_At__c, CreatedDate FROM Support_Ticket__c ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 100

ee:variables.ee:set-variable:
%dw 2.0 output text/plain var reportDate = (now() as DateTime) as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"} var genAt = now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"} var tickets = payload default [] var count = sizeOf(tickets) var isNil = count == 0 var nilFlag = if (isNil) 1 else 0
var headerLine = "H,TICKET_REPORT," ++ reportDate ++ "," ++ genAt ++ ",v1" var columnHeaderLine = "ticketId,createdAt,customerId,tier,product,category,priority,team,assignedTo,status,ackDueAt,acknowledgedAt,ackBreached,resolutionDueAt,resolvedAt,resBreached,ruleId"
var dataLines = if (isNil) [] else tickets map ((t) -> [ t.Name default "", if (t.CreatedDate != null) (t.CreatedDate as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}) else "", t.Customer_ID__c default "", t.Customer_Tier__c default "STANDARD", t.Product_Code__c default "", t.Category_Code__c default "", t.Priority__c default "P3", t.Assigned_Team__c default "TRIAGE", "", t.Ticket_Status__c default "NEW", if (t.Acknowledgement_Due_At__c != null) (t.Acknowledgement_Due_At__c as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}) else "", "", "N", if (t.Resolution_Due_At__c != null) (t.Resolution_Due_At__c as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssXXX"}) else "", "", "N", "RR-014" ] joinBy "," )
var trailerLine = "T," ++ (count as String) ++ ",0,0,0," ++ (nilFlag as String) ++ "," ++ genAt --- (([headerLine, columnHeaderLine] ++ dataLines ++ [trailerLine]) joinBy "\n")

logger.message: #['[Report Published] CSV created at ' ++ p('report.exportDir') ++ '/' ++ vars.finalFileName]
logger.doc:name: Log Report Created

email:send.doc:name: Send Email with CSV Attachment
email:send.subject: #['Daily Support Ticket Report - ' ++ (now() as DateTime as String {format: 'yyyy-MM-dd'})]

email:body.email:content: #[%dw 2.0 output text/plain --- "Attached is the daily support ticket export report.\n" ++ "Report Date: " ++ (now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd"}) ++ "\n" ++ "Total Records: " ++ (vars.recordCount as String)]

logger.message: #['[Email Sent] Management report sent to ' ++ p('report.mgmtEmail')]
logger.doc:name: Log email sent

logger.message: #['[SMTP Offline] Management report email skipped. File is saved on disk.']
logger.doc:name: Log SMTP Error
